# Finality Market Intelligence

> Agent- and user-accessible market, AI, and Hedera on-chain intelligence — paid per result with HBAR or USDC via x402.

## Platform
- Website: https://finality.accuracy.wtf
- API: https://finality-x402-backend.onrender.com
- Facilitator: https://api.testnet.blocky402.com (Blocky402)
- Network: Hedera testnet · Assets: USDC (0.0.429274) and HBAR (0.0.0)
- Tags: finality, x402, hedera, hbar, usdc
